snippet.title: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2013 (PS3) - Gameplay
snippet.description: A full game of Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2013 (Professional Baseball Spirits), a video game by Konami for PlayStation 3. Hiroshima Carp vs. Seibu Lions in the "USA Stadium." Kenta Maeda is pitching for the Carp here and Shogo Akiyama is playing center field for the Lions.
